value.rationale: The object is a canonical family of associative class-two nilpotent algebras built from nondegenerate alternating forms, with meaningful endomorphism monoids. The finding gives a uniform complete rank polynomial in every finite characteristic, exhibiting a structural gap between singular and invertible ranks, and a sharp m=2 crossover between asymptotically automorphism-dominated and singular-dominated monoids. Those are nontrivial structural and enumeration invariants; the derivation requires form-preservation, isotropic-subspace counts, and a nontrivial central-functional rank split, not a mere tiny example or renamed textbook identity. Caveat: basic symplectic enumerations are standard components.
